kjv.text: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

bsb.text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.

web.text: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

flow.say: Henry shows that Jesus will return as the Master to judge his servants, and we must stay watchful because we do not know when.
The Master may come at any hour of the night—evening, midnight, or dawn—so we cannot know the time of his arrival or our death.
We must guard against being found asleep and unprepared, secure in ourselves and careless about our duty.
His coming will be sudden and a shock to those who are careless, arriving like a thief in the night.

morning.say: Carry into today the call to stay ready, since you do not know when the Master will come.
